description: Add a realistic mirror reflection under your photo with a smooth fade — adjustable height and gap.

faqs.a: The reflection is your photo flipped vertically with a gradient mask that fades it out, plus a subtle darkening for realism.
Increase the fade height or lower the start opacity for a longer, softer reflection.
faqs.q: How do I make the fade longer?

faqs.a: Yes — everything is rendered on a canvas in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

howto: Drag the reflection height slider to set how tall the mirror image is.
Adjust the gap and fade to taste.
Click "Download image" to save the PNG.
title: Reflection Effect
